title: Unblocked the Amazon Pay general availability launch in two days
summary: The wallet's general availability was blocked because its orders were not recognized as a valid payment instrument; I was called in, found the root cause in two days and agreed a fix at the source with the payments team.
what_would_have_happened: The launch slips, or a patch in our fraud service hides a data problem upstream.
the_call: Fix the mapping where the data starts, with no code change in our service.
what_i_did: Traced retail and digital wallet orders, showed the payment type was being sent wrongly, and worked the fix through with the payments engineers until the logs confirmed it.
what_changed: The fix was confirmed and cleared for production on 25 Jul 2017, and a senior engineering manager called the resolution 'simple and right'.

quotes.text: Thanks Datta for relentlessly pursuing this or the last 2 days and getting to the root cause and the solution.
Thanks [a colleague] and Datta and the IN team for arriving at this resolution, which is simple and right.
